name: blackraptor-engineering
description: Specialist agent packs with read-only review gates: they judge the work and record a cited verdict, machine-checked as it is written. A governed software-engineering team: a process orchestrator, a principal architect, engineers, and blocking-gate reviewers (security, privacy, compliance, red-team), plus the advisory completion-auditor verification pass. Ships shared skills — excellence-pass, gate-verdict-format, enforcement-liveness, change-record, stride-review, owasp-llm-checklist, expand-contract-migration. Auto-pulls the `blackraptor-core` pack (shared `product-manager` and `evidence-auditor` agents + the `research-integrity` skill).
